as_told.title: Asking General Curtis LeMay to enter the secret room at Wright-Patterson

plain: Senator Barry Goldwater said he once asked General Curtis LeMay of the Air Force to let him into a secret room at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio where, he believed, UFO material was kept, and LeMay swore at him. In a recording Michels plays on many episodes, Goldwater says: "I called Curtis LeMay and I said, General, I know we have a room at Wright-Patterson where you put all this secret stuff. Can I go in there?" He goes on: "I've never heard him get mad, but he got mad as hell at me, cussed me out, said don't ever ask me that question." Michels names him and calls the place the Blue Room, dating it to the 1960s or 70s. The tellings disagree on who is speaking: one episode presents the voice as an unnamed politician, and another frames it as the experience of Harald Malmgren, a former presidential adviser. So the story rests on one man's recorded words, replayed by the host. If true, even a senator was refused a look at what the base held.
